label: Diagram 2.7
caption: Diagram 2.7 Fire resistance of areas near to external stairs
description:
This is a section drawing titled at the bottom in a green band, "Diagram 2.7 Fire resistance of areas near to external stairs". A legend on the left defines a green square as "Fire resisting construction (minimum RE 30)" and "Fd" as "Fire doorset". Top left reads "See para 2.17", and a NOTE states "6m max. stair height without weather protection."

The central section shows an external staircase with an upper landing and flights of stairs descending to ground level (the grey line labelled "Ground level"), drawn with a stepped flight profile on the left and a hatched flight on the right. A green shaded mass, the fire resisting construction, forms a box around the stair, extending from above the top landing down to ground level and out at the side of the stairway. The mass is labelled "1100mm above top landing" at its upper left, "9m below stair flights and landings" with a leader line to its left face, and "1800mm at side of stairway" with a leader line to its right side wall. Two doorsets, each labelled "Fd", are shown at the right side of the stairway, one above the other, the lower one at ground level. At the top, a rectangular door opening at the upper landing is indicated by the label "No fire resistance required for door" with a vertical leader line. At the bottom, a vertical leader line from the label "Fire resisting window (minimum RE 30)" points up to the front face of the green construction at ground level.
